HOW IT WORKS

YOU CALL THE PLAY.

Choose a player role and late-match score. Write actions like pass into the middle, cross, shoot, dribble, or hold. Players, defenders and the ball move between decisions. A successful pass gives the receiver the next turn.

Commands use a transparent rule-based parser, not live AI. It recognizes common English and Vietnamese expressions but cannot understand unrestricted tactical language. Feedback and outcomes are simplified teaching examples rather than realistic game predictions.

The play finishes on a goal, turnover or the final whistle. No account, tracking or API key is required.
